## About
Miami Clutch & Transmission is a family operated business, and we are the oldest clutch house in Miami. Clutches are what we know, for most automotive, industrial and truck applications.
We carry clutch parts from Valeo, Illinois, AMS, Unique, MidAmerica, Seco, Spicer/Eaton, Lipe and others, and we sell retail, wholesale and export. Our rates are competitive, with no hidden fees, and our people will walk you through every step.
Customers have given us a 4.2 rating across 34 Google reviews. Several mention honest service, and one said we showed him how to drive to make his clutch last.

## Services
- Clutch service: Clutch work for most automotive, industrial and truck applications.
- Transmission service: Transmission work alongside our clutch work.
- Clutch parts: A customer mentioned finding the parts he needed in stock at good prices.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on trucks and industrial equipment, or just cars?
A: We handle clutches for most automotive, industrial and truck applications.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we are open Saturday from 8 AM to 12 PM.
